sources.title: 北京航空航天大学 2026 年国际本科生项目招生简章
北京航空航天大学 2026 年国际学生本科专业 CSCA 测试科目要求

requirements.ruleText: Be a non-Chinese citizen holding a valid foreign passport and meet the applicable Chinese nationality-law and Ministry of Education Document No. 12 (2020) rules.
Have at least a high-school education, be physically and mentally healthy, demonstrate good conduct and goodwill toward China, and normally be 18 to 22 years old.
Complete the online application and all material corrections between November 1, 2025 and June 30, 2026.
Take the CSCA and upload the result to the Beihang application system no later than May 30, 2026.
Register with a personal email address in the Beihang international-student online application system and complete the online form.
Upload the ordinary-passport information page; the passport must remain valid beyond March 1, 2027. Applicants in mainland China must also provide their current visa or residence-permit page.
Upload the high-school diploma; current students may submit an expected-graduation certificate but must provide the formal diploma before final admission and present the original at registration.
Upload transcripts for all high-school courses.
Upload a Foreigner Physical Examination Form and blood-test report completed within six months, in Chinese or English, signed by a physician and stamped by the examining institution.
Upload the financial guarantor letter and evidence of the guarantor's financial capacity, showing either a bank deposit of at least four years' tuition or annual income of at least CNY 30,000.

Upload the applicant's birth certificate and documents proving both parents' nationality status when the applicant was born, including relevant passports, identity cards or permanent-residence records.
Upload a no-criminal-record certificate issued within six months; applicants currently in China must use a certificate from the local entry-exit authority.
Upload the integrity commitment letter; authenticity problems result in immediate cancellation of application eligibility.
Submit a notarized Guardian Guarantee whose guardian is normally an income-earning adult residing in the relevant campus city, Beijing or Hangzhou.
Upload relevant supplementary records such as award certificates, a résumé or a portfolio.

requirements.appliesTo: Applicants with records not originally in Chinese or English
requirements.ruleText: Provide notarized translations for every original document not written in Chinese or English.
Provide the required painting portfolio.
Pay the non-refundable CNY 400 online application fee and upload the payment receipt before formally submitting the application.

references.locator: Section III, step 4 and Section IV

requirements.ruleText: Purchase four academic years of comprehensive medical insurance at registration for a total published fee of CNY 3,200.

Reserve accommodation in advance. Published double-room rates are CNY 30 per bed per day in Beijing and CNY 2,000 to 2,500 per academic year at the Hangzhou International Campus, excluding utilities and subject to actual assignment.

Review the published Chinese Government, Beihang and Beijing scholarship routes. Except for the Chinese Government Scholarship, submit the applicable scholarship materials together with the admission application by the published May 30, 2026 scholarship deadline.
Submit an HSK Level 5 result of at least 180 issued within two years.

requirements.appliesTo: Chinese-taught applicants in this program group
requirements.ruleText: Submit results for Chinese (for Science Disciplines), Mathematics, Chemistry; take the subjects in Chinese.

references.locator: Official 2026 CSCA subject table, matching program rows

requirements.appliesTo: Enrolled applicants in this program group
requirements.ruleText: Pay annual tuition of RMB 25,000 per year.

unresolvedNotes: This is a closed historical Fall 2026 route and must not be presented as a current application window.

sources.title: Beihang Major Catalogue of Master Programs for International Students

requirements.ruleText: Be a citizen of a country other than the People's Republic of China and be in good mental and physical health.
Hold a bachelor's degree and be under 35 years old.
Submit an HSK Level 5 score of at least 180 issued within two years; applicants whose previous education at a Chinese university was taught in Chinese may use the published exemption.
Apply online from November 1, 2025 through June 30, 2026; scholarship routes may use separate deadlines.
Register in September 2026 on the specific date published in the admission notice.
Apply through the Beihang international-student online application system and upload every required document.
Upload the Master Program application form generated by the online system.
Upload the ordinary-passport information page; the passport must remain valid beyond September 2026.
Upload a notarized highest diploma; expected graduates may submit official student-status evidence showing the expected graduation date.
Upload sealed academic transcripts covering study from the undergraduate stage onward.
Submit the Beihang supervisor acceptance letter; the guide states that all master's applicants should provide it in principle.
Submit a study plan written in Chinese or English containing more than 1,000 characters or words using the published form.
Submit two Chinese- or English-language recommendation letters from professors or associate professors, including a comprehensive evaluation.
Submit a complete Foreigner Physical Examination Form valid for six months with the required final opinion, physician signature, hospital stamp and sealed photograph.
Submit a valid no-criminal-record certificate issued by the local public-security authority, normally within six months before application.
